label: accepted

evidence.V1: Four-poster bed reads from front, 3/4, top and silhouette: arched headboard, taller head posts with ball finials, footboard, pillow and turned-down blanket; front outline symmetric (A15 X 0.0).
evidence.V2: Clear: frame + mattress (big), headboard arch, blanket and pillow (medium), gold ball finials and blanket cuff (small).
evidence.V3: Chunky posts, arched headboard and fat rounded pillow give a confident cozy stylised read; mattress and blanket are fairly plain slabs.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on posts, rails and headboard edge (light-catching rim on the arch); soft rounded edges on mattress and pillow.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean, but the blanket cuff ends in a boxy block whose end face shows a lighter patch and sits proud of the blanket side, reading as a pasted-on piece in the blanket-fold close-up (minor).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: one fabric hue in 2 values (blanket + cuff), cream sheet/pillow, frame wood in 2 values, gold finials; colourways swap only the fabric hue.
evidence.V8: One LF_VertexColor material, smooth shading, chamfered frame, gold and warm cream accents per furniture spec.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates pass.

evidence.V1: Four posts with gold ball finials, arched headboard, pillow and turned-down blanket read as a bed from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette; front outline symmetric (A15 X 0.0).
evidence.V2: Big frame + mattress, medium headboard/footboard/blanket/pillow, small gold finials and the blanket turn-down band - clear hierarchy.
evidence.V3: Arched headboard and ball finials add character, but posts are plain square boxes, foot/side boards flat slabs and the mattress/blanket rigid boxes with no sag or drape - only partly stylised.
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers on posts, boards, headboard arch and blanket band; pillow is evenly rounded; edges catch light in the close-ups.
evidence.V5: Headboard, pillow and blanket close-ups shade cleanly with no seams, pinches or z-fighting; the turn-down band end steps slightly past the blanket side but reads as a fold, not an artifact.
evidence.V6: Blanket hue in two values, cream sheets/pillow, wood in two values, gold finials; colourways swap only the blanket hue.
evidence.V7: 984 tris vs medium target 2000: under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, kit gold and warm cream, chamfer size and smooth shading match the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, bottom-centre origin, MeshPart white with vertex colours.

evidence.V1: Four posts with gold ball finials, arched headboard, mattress, pillow and blanket read as a bed from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette.
evidence.V2: Big (frame + mattress), medium (arched headboard, footboard, blanket, pillow), small (gold finials, blanket fold band) hierarchy is clear.
evidence.V3: Arched headboard and fat pillow are stylised, but the corner posts are plain square boxes and the blanket is a flat slab with a boxy fold, so it reads partly primitive.
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers catch light on the headboard arch, pillow ends, blanket fold edge and post tops.
evidence.V5: Close-ups of pillow, headboard and blanket fold show smooth shading with no pinches, seams or z-fighting; X symmetry 0.0.
evidence.V6: Wood frame in 2-3 values, cream bedding, one fabric hue (blanket) in two values, gold finials; disciplined.
evidence.V8: Vertex-coloured wood + one fabric hue, kit cream and gold, chamfered edges consistent with the furniture kit.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; A1-A18 pass.

artifacts: Blanket turn-down cuff end is a boxy block with a lighter end-face patch protruding past the blanket side
top_fixes: Wrap the blanket cuff around the mattress side (or round its end) so it reads as folded fabric rather than a stuck-on block
Let the blanket drape slightly over the mattress sides for a softer silhouette
Add a slight taper or cap moulding to the posts to push the stylisation further
Let the blanket drape over the mattress sides with a soft rounded overhang and slight sag instead of a rigid slab
Turn the square posts into turned/tapered posts and give the footboard a shaped top rail
Add a slight puff/indent to the pillow and mattress edges for a cosier stylised read
Give the corner posts a turned or tapered profile (or a cap/foot step) instead of plain square boxes
Soften the blanket into a draped shape that hangs over the mattress sides with a rounded fold
Add a slight sag/puff to the mattress top so the bedding reads less like stacked boxes
